data.narrative:
Sorcerer is a Seed-stage Space & Aerospace company founded by Austin Tindle, Maxmillion McLaughlin, and Alessandro Vecchi, having raised $3.9M to date. The Space & Aerospace sector comprises 6 public comparables (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and a competitive private peer set including SpaceX, Rocket Lab, and ICEYE.

Given data constraints, only the Stage-Progression method is applicable. Using total capital raised ($3.9M) as a valuation proxy and applying a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of Seed-to-Series A advancement, this method implies a $9.75M post-money valuation. A Peer-Median approach could not be executed due to insufficient same-stage and adjacent-stage comparables within the Space & Aerospace sector (fewer than 3 datapoints meeting filter criteria). Public-Comp anchoring using the sector's 27.4x median P/S multiple cannot be applied without revenue disclosure, which is standard for private companies at this stage.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $8.0M to $11.2M, with a median point of $10.0M. This range reflects primarily a single methodological input, limiting confidence. Key uncertainties include the absence of direct peer transactions at Seed stage in the sector and lack of revenue visibility needed to validate multiples against public comparables. Additional deal precedent or revenue guidance would strengthen conviction in this range.
